Question
========
If `data.shape` returns `(60, 40)`, what do 60 and 40 represent?

Answerlist
-----------
* 60 columns and 40 rows
* 60 patients and 40 days
* 60 days and 40 patients
* 60 files and 40 variables
* 60 trials and 40 participants
* 60 bytes and 40 words

Solution
========
The data has 60 patients (rows) and 40 days (columns).
